remarks: Move-in ready 2 bedroom 1 bath townhouse-style condominium with reserved parking, a private gated patio, and a finished lower level. Freshly painted throughout, including walls, ceilings, and all trim in white semi-gloss. Deck has also been freshly painted. Clean, bright, and available now. Updated kitchen with dark wood cabinetry, granite-look counters, tiled backsplash, and stainless appliances including refrigerator, dishwasher, and range. Living area with hardwood floors and sliding glass doors to the private outdoor space. Two bedrooms with hardwood flooring, generous windows, and wall air conditioning. Full bath updated with glass shower enclosure, marble-look vanity, and tiled flooring. Finished lower level offers flexible bonus space for a rec room or office, plus in-unit laundry: washer included; tenant to supply dryer. Assigned reserved parking for this unit. Private patio with its own gate. Electric baseboard heat. No pets. No smoking.
